[Workshop participants]{.eyebrow}

The 2026 AIM workshop drew on expertise spanning mathematical biology, dynamical systems, ecology, entomology, virology, data science, geospatial analysis, and commercial beekeeping, across multiple institutions and countries. That breadth — from differential equations to hive management — is itself one of the collaboration's most important assets.
